scripts.test:api-retry: node --test tests/api_retry_unit.test.js || echo "test file not present (upload/web/tests/ is local-only, git-ignored)"
scripts.lint: echo 'Linting: check for console.log with sensitive data' && grep -rn 'console\.log.*\(token\|secret\|password\|plain_key\)' assets/js/ || echo 'No sensitive data in console.log'
scripts.check-size: echo 'JS file sizes:' && wc -l assets/js/*.js | sort -rn | head -10
